title: AC1024 physical MLINESTYLE sentinel output and associative class admission
scope: One source-backed MLINESTYLE output profile plus the associative class-routing fixes needed to advance the existing physical witness. This does not close P4 or promote whole-file support.

source.qualificationMode: explicit partial read only; strict complete export remains blocked by the incomplete DWG read disposition

odaSpec.finding: Before R2018, each MLINESTYLE line stores its linetype index as BS; R2018 and later store a hard-pointer linetype handle.

independentOpenSourceCrosscheck.finding: The R2018 upgrade maps index 0 to CONTINUOUS, 32767 to BYLAYER and 32766 to BYBLOCK; the DXF schema maps the same pre-R2018 indices to group 6 names.

tableStyleOutputSchema.odaSection: 20.4.101.2 R24 TABLESTYLE format, plus 20.4.101.3 Content format and 20.4.101.4 Cell style
tableStyleOutputSchema.finding: The physical AC1024 object takes the R24 parser path. Existing DXF group codes still define description, flow, flags, margins, title/header suppression and repeated title/header/data cell style fields; R24 DWG style prefix values documented as unknown remain uninterpreted.

associativeClasses.finding: The selected source record had a canonical class profile and typed writer but was missing from class admission and OBJECTS writer dispatch. It is now admitted and sent to writeAssociativeDependency.

This source alias is admitted only from one complete, finalized, published source CLASS row with validated class number and flags; its exact source row is emitted instead of substituting generic canonical metadata.

mlineStyle.name: STANDARD
mlineStyle.finding: The AC1024 signed-BS values are the built-in BYLAYER sentinel. The writer previously rejected every set index as unresolved, even when it had a defined sentinel meaning.

nextPhysicalFailure.name: Standard
nextPhysicalFailure.diagnostic: tablestyle-unsupported-profile: TABLESTYLE does not contain exactly three row styles

parsedModel.commonObservedStyleData: Each standard style has six borders with edge flags 1,2,4,8,16,32; property overrides are 0, border type is 1, ACI color is 0, lineweight is -2, linetype handle is 0, source invisibility is 0, and double-line spacing is 0.045.

changes: Admit ACDBASSOCDEPENDENCY and route it through the existing typed associative dependency writer.
Admit the source alias ASSOCDIMDEPENDENCYBODY using its exact validated published CLASS row.

Emit pre-R2018 MLINESTYLE linetype indices 0, 32767 and 32766 as CONTINUOUS, BYLAYER and BYBLOCK; continue refusing ordinary indices without a uniquely source-bound linetype name and refuse unresolved handles.
Add focused ASCII and Binary DXF controls for all three known values and for refusal of an unknown index before record publication.
Add phase-level OBJECTS and TABLESTYLE rejection diagnostics to locate the next physical witness failure.

validation.physicalWitness: EXPECTED FAILURE AFTER PROGRESS: explicit-partial AC1024 conversion passes the associative and MLINESTYLE phases, then refuses TABLESTYLE handle 0x87; process exits 1 and no DXF output is published.

evidenceLimits: The physical DWG remains outside the repository; no DWG/DXF fixture was added.
Only the three source-established built-in linetype index values are promoted by this slice. Other table indices require source-bound LTYPE identity and remain refused.
The run used --allow-partial-dwg-read and is diagnostic evidence only; strict-complete export and full source graph closure remain unqualified.
No native CAD rendering or independent consumer semantic evidence is established by serializer tests.
next: Add an AC1024+ TABLESTYLE DXF output path for the observed R24 model. Map standard role IDs 1/2/3 to the DXF title/header/data records, preserve the ID-4 Table style and CELLSTYLEMAP dependency where representable, and refuse unknown or unrepresented R24 fields. Prove exact output/readback with locally authored ASCII/Binary controls before retrying the physical witness; keep strict-complete admission closed.
